core_concepts: RULE 1: If you want to avoid worry, do what Sir William Osier did: Live in “day-tight compartments”
RULE 2: The next time Trouble-with a capital T- comes gunning for you and backs you up in a corner, try the magic formula of Willis H
Ask yourself, “What is the worst that can possibly happen if I can’t solve my problem?” Prepare yourself mentally to accept the worst-if necessary
Carrier: Ask yourself, “What is the worst that can possibly happen if I can’t solve my problem?” Prepare yourself mentally to accept the worst-if necessary
Just live each day until bedtime
Then calmly try to improve upon the worst-which you have already mentally • agreed to accept.RULE 3: Remind yourself of the exorbitant price you can pay for worry in terms of your health
